title: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated (Python 3.12+)
suggestion: Use datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat() to avoid the deprecation warning

title: PUT performs a full replacement rather than a partial update
evidence: app.py:187 requires title and author on every PUT via validate_book_data(require_title=True, require_author=True)
suggestion: Optional: support partial updates (PATCH semantics); the spec does not require it, so this is conformant as-is

title: Test DB isolation relies on monkeypatching module-level DATABASE
evidence: test_app.py:46-47 reassigns app_module.DATABASE = test_db; works because get_db() reads the global at request time
suggestion: Optional: use Flask config / an app factory for cleaner test isolation
